USMLE-style practice · Pharmacology

Clinical pharmacology foundations: 5

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A patient benefits from a medicine at moderate exposure but develops serious toxicity when exposure rises only slightly. Which concept describes the limited separation between beneficial and harmful concentrations relevant to monitoring this treatment?

  1. Bioavailability
  2. Clearance
  3. Therapeutic window
  4. Pharmacokinetics
  5. Pharmacodynamics
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Therapeutic window

The therapeutic window separates exposures associated with benefit from those causing unacceptable toxicity.

Understanding the options

Therapeutic window
The therapeutic window separates exposures associated with benefit from those causing unacceptable toxicity.
Pharmacokinetics
Pharmacokinetics describes absorption, distribution, metabolism and elimination and their effects on drug concentration. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Pharmacodynamics
Pharmacodynamics relates drug concentration and target interaction to biological effects. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Bioavailability
Bioavailability is the fraction of an administered dose reaching systemic circulation unchanged. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Clearance
Clearance expresses the volume of plasma effectively cleared of drug per unit time. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
